[Issue #8941] Add config for workflow allowed approval types (#9494)

## Summary

Fixes #8941  

## Changes proposed

To our approval config we should add a new configuration called
allowed_approval_response_types that defaults to a set of all 3 values.

With this configuration we should add validation to the API & service
that the approval response type for the given approval event is allowed.

The API response for GET workflow should return this as well.

## Context for reviewers

When a user handles an approval they can approve / decline / require
modification. Those 3 values may not always make sense to do. We've
heard that generally users can't decline something, and requiring
modification might not make sense. Rather than needing every state
transition to need to account for all of these values, we should make
the approval configuration be able to restrict the allowed values.

## Validation steps

- Configuration added with default of all 3 values
- Add validation to use the configuration
- Adjust/add a test scenario to the test state machine that only allows
a subset of the values to verify it works
- The GET workflow endpoint response schema should be modified to return
this information so the user knows which they can do

---------

Co-authored-by: Hao Wang <hao.wang@reisystems.com>

[Issue #8941] Add config for workflow allowed approval types (#9494)

## Summary

Fixes #8941  

## Changes proposed

To our approval config we should add a new configuration called
allowed_approval_response_types that defaults to a set of all 3 values.

With this configuration we should add validation to the API & service
that the approval response type for the given approval event is allowed.

The API response for GET workflow should return this as well.

## Context for reviewers

When a user handles an approval they can approve / decline / require
modification. Those 3 values may not always make sense to do. We've
heard that generally users can't decline something, and requiring
modification might not make sense. Rather than needing every state
transition to need to account for all of these values, we should make
the approval configuration be able to restrict the allowed values.

## Validation steps

- Configuration added with default of all 3 values
- Add validation to use the configuration
- Adjust/add a test scenario to the test state machine that only allows
a subset of the values to verify it works
- The GET workflow endpoint response schema should be modified to return
this information so the user knows which they can do

---------

Co-authored-by: Hao Wang <hao.wang@reisystems.com>

[Issue #8573] FieldList Required Fields and Error Messages (#9445)

## Summary

Work for #8573

This PR adds full `FieldList` (repeatable field) support with correct
row-aware validation. It enables child field changes, maps validation
errors to the correct row, preserves multiple row-specific warnings, and
links summary messages directly to the affected inputs.

## Changes proposed

- Added full `FieldList` support in the form system
- Implemented row-aware validation handling for `FieldList` child fields
- Updated validation pipeline to support **multiple warnings per field
definition**
- Ensured inline errors render on the correct row only
- Enabled summary links to anchor to the exact errored input
- Improved validation deduplication to preserve row-specific warnings
- Added _FieldList-specific_ helpers for group and child error handling
- Updated getFieldConfig to properly wire `FieldList` data, schema, and
errors
- Added group-level error rendering for array-level validation (e.g.
empty list)

## Validation steps

- Sign in
- Type "test" in search
- Open "**Test Opportunity for FIELDLIST_DEMO_DO_NOT_SYNC 1.0"**

### Test FieldList behavior
- Leave all fields empty and click Save
  - Verify:
    - [ ] Summary shows validation errors
    - [ ] Links navigate to the correct inputs

  - Add multiple FieldList entries (e.g. 3 rows)
    - Fill First Name in row 1 only
    - Leave rows 2 and 3 empty
    - Click Save
    - Verify:
      - [ ] Errors appear only on rows 2 and 3 (not row 1)
      - [ ] Summary shows multiple entries (e.g. Entry 2, Entry 3)
      - [ ] Each link navigates to the correct row

  - Fix one invalid row (e.g. fill First Name in row 2)
    - Click Save
    - Verify:
      - [ ] Error for that row disappears
      - [ ] Remaining row still shows error

  - Add a new row after validation errors exist
  - Verify:
    - [ ] New row does not inherit errors incorrectly
    - [ ] Remove a row with errors

  - Verify:
    - [ ] Errors update correctly in both UI and summary

  - Submit with all fields valid
  - Verify:
    - [ ] No validation errors shown
    - [ ] Success message appears
